LESSON: GOD’S PLAN FOR REDEMPTION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CREATION
Topic 1.2: God’s Plan for Redemption

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: God’s Plan for Redemption
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is God’s redemptive plan important to human kind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man
2. explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man
3. appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man

▸ Skill 3: appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man
• Model 2: explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man
• Model 3: appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe how God demonstrated love to humankind after the fall of man
2. Practise: explain the importance of redemption after the fall of man
3. Practise: appreciate God’s saving grace in their day-to-day life

SECTION: WORK TO DO
